officialAccount.evidence: The official account describes reaming from the guide into the cover and making fitted bolts. This supports separate guides attached to cover-side support, not an assumed fully monolithic guide assembly.

photo1125.observed: The visible upper fasteners enter the lower support approximately up/down in the photograph. They are not evidence for bolts along the spindle axis through the circular pressure cover.
photo1125.candidateMapping: Keep the separate guide strip/cap and Y-axis screws into its own lower support. Their exact size, count and locomotive-frame axis mapping remain candidate.

photo1117.limitation: The clamping plate and long rods shown during alignment are tooling, not verified permanent locomotive fasteners.

unresolvedInterface.scope: The current geometry terminates at the cover face and shares a fixed parent. Whether the lower arm is a cast cover extension or a separate physical attachment has not been established. Shared parent and coplanar contact are not proof of a reconstructed physical joint.
